## What are you adding?

<!-- One line. One entry per PR is preferred — it makes review fast. -->

## Have you used it? What for?

<!-- Required. Be specific. "It has a lot of stars" is not an answer. -->

## Are you affiliated with this project?

<!-- Required. Self-submissions are fine if you actually use it — undisclosed or automated ones are not.
     PRs opened by automated tools, AI agents, or distribution campaigns are closed without review. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Link works, and the repository contains an actual implementation
      (not only manifests, registry files, and a logo)
- [ ] Description is one sentence in my own words, not the project's marketing copy
- [ ] Entry added to **both** `README.md` and `README.zh-CN.md`
      (if you can't write the Chinese, say so and it will be added on merge)
- [ ] Tagged `(Paid)` if it is paid or freemium; `(Official)` / `(Chinese)` / `(Community)` as applicable
- [ ] Em dash ` — ` between the link and the description, not a hyphen
- [ ] Placed in the right section, in alphabetical order within it
